author: mariitais

title: Can’t share lists between work accounts
body:
Easy setup on my iPhone using my work Microsoft account since I was already using it on my device. Same on my wife’s device but we can’t share anything berween us because there are some weird restrictions. A total showstopper since this was the only feature we were looking for coming from Wunderlist. That is, an easy way to share lists between us. Deleted the app immediately and will be switching to To doist or something similar. 
I am not willing to setup a new private Microsoft account for simply sharing lists.
author: Gamlibongo

title: Why can’t we just keep Wunderlist?
body: I’ve been a heavy Wunderlist user for years, and this new app just doesn’t cut it. Please kill To do and let us keep using Wunderlist. Listen to your users, instead of inposing an inferior app on us with ‘features’ no one ever asked for.

title: Hated To do!!
body: After years of happiness with Wunderlist i got kicked out and told to use To Do. Me and my husband downloaded it but there was no way we could connect in an easy way, we tried bot through our work mail and gmail. Lots of frustration before we deleted it and tried cozi, which worked wonderfully in the first minutes and still does.
